target.title: fix(oauth): bind portal login to initiating browser
target.body:
## Summary

Bind portal GitHub OAuth attempts to the browser that initiated them.

## Current draft status

This draft currently contains focused regression coverage for the browser-binding behavior. The production implementation is being completed on the same branch before review.

## Intended change

- issue a short-lived HttpOnly host cookie at portal login
- retain only its hash in pending OAuth state
- validate the binding before exchanging the authorization code
- clear the binding after terminal outcomes
- preserve the existing CLI OAuth flow

## Validation

- focused OAuth regression tests
- TypeScript check, lint, and formatting before marking ready
